description: This file defines a composable UI component for an Android application that displays a camera flash overlay with fade-in and fade-out animation effects.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: A composable function that overlays a camera flash effect on the screen, triggered by a token.

classes.name: CameraFlash
classes.description: A private composable that animates the alpha transparency of a white background to simulate a flash.

methods.name: CameraFlashOverlay
methods.description: Creates a full-screen overlay with a white background triggered by a token.

methods.name: CameraFlash
methods.description: Animates the alpha transparency for the flash effect based on a token.
